item.title: Scaffold 2.0.9
item.description:
What's New in 2.0.9

  • Added a Flame media panel workspace editor — define reel groups, standalone reels, and batch groups that get pre-built into every new Flame project's desktop automatically, matching your studio's conventions.
  • Added "Show in Finder" quick links next to the Starters Folder and Structure Folder fields in Preferences, the main window's Basic panel, and first-launch onboarding.
  • Fixed a bug causing Scaffold to fail to launch on older Macs — the app was incorrectly requiring macOS 26.2; it now correctly supports macOS 13 Ventura and later.
